description: This bar chart compares the performance of three models—mBERT, XLM-R, and same—across nine language families, with the vertical axis labeled “task count” ranging from 0 to 40 on a linear scale, and the horizontal axis listing the language families in alphabetical order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The chart uses grouped bars for each language family, where each group contains three bars: a light blue bar representing mBERT, a dark blue bar representing XLM-R, and a light green bar representing same. The approximate values for each bar are as follows: for IE-Baltic, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~10, and same is ~7; for IE-Germanic, mBERT is ~4, XLM-R is ~18, and same is ~22; for IE-Indic, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~5, and same is ~4; for IE-Romance, mBERT is ~4, XLM-R is ~13, and same is ~30; for IE-Slavic, mBERT is ~12, XLM-R is ~39, and same is ~28; for IE-other, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~6, and same is ~8; for Isolate, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~5, and same is ~1; for Semitic, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~7, and same is ~1; and for Uralic, mBERT is ~1, XLM-R is ~14, and same is ~5. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the language families listed on the x-axis, with no visual emphasis applied to any specific bar.
